_comment: Forever Party Rentals — single source of truth for brand/identity constants. Loaded by render_partials.py and the 5 page generators (city, product, sku, package, christmas-lights). The sitemap generator and verify.py also read siteUrl. When changing any value here, regenerate all pages: python3 _build/generate_city_pages.py --all && python3 _build/generate_product_pages.py --all && python3 _build/generate_sku_pages.py --all && python3 _build/generate_package_pages.py --all && python3 _build/generate_christmas_light_pages.py --all && python3 _build/generate_sitemap.py && python3 _build/apply_partials.py --all

aggregateRating._note: Pulled from public Google Business Profile. Update both this number and the human-facing '212+ five-star Google reviews' copy in templates whenever the GBP changes — never inflate. Marketing floor is 212+ while live GBP is at or above that.
